pros: The drag-and-drop editor and pre-built templates simplify email campaign creation.
The unified platform integrates email, landing page, and automation tools, streamlining workflows.

cons: The navigation structure can be cumbersome, with many core features nested deep within a mega-menu.
The contact counting logic could lead to unpredictable billing for managing multiple client lists.
The landing page builder and some template customization options might feel limited.
